required_units: The navigation action succeeded, so the question's failure premise is false for this episode.
No terminal failure chain is established; the response must not invent a failure mechanism or external failure criterion.
The fully covered requested-route audit found no costmap cell at or above 253 and measured 0.379 m minimum clearance from a lethal cell.
Delivered odometry records 17.477 m maximum forward progress and only 0.084 m maximum lateral deviation.
The action completed 20.381 s before the exact configured 90.0 s behavior-tree deadline; a 70 s deadline does not apply to this executed tree.
The answer withholds universal obstacle freedom, a unique physical obstacle, transient-history completeness, and proven Nav2 consumption.
The answer treats the run as a nominal comparator and recommends synchronized plans and costmaps only if transient restrictions are the question of interest.
prohibited_claims: An external evaluator rejected the outcome or imposed a stricter completion criterion.
A 70 s behavior-tree deadline applied to this episode.
The retained snapshot proves universal obstacle freedom or every transient route state.
The retained snapshot was proven to be consumed by every planning invocation.
A particular physical obstacle or control fault caused the outcome.

limits: The action status is sufficient to reject the failure premise.
